platformOnlyTests.rationale: Exercises Windows file-share locks that prevent vault replacement before SQLite opens the guarded file.
Exercises Windows junction traversal, which is distinct from portable symbolic-link handling.
Exercises Windows file identity and sharing semantics during atomic vault publication.
Exercises Windows metadata revalidation when a linked staging file is mutated during publication.
Exercises Windows share-mode protection for the reserved staging file during vault initialization.
Exercises Windows share-mode protection across password work and unlocked-session publication.
Exercises Unix permission bits, which do not exist under Windows access-control-list semantics.
Exercises Unix inode binding while the reserved staging file is initialized.
Exercises Unix special-file handling without opening potentially blocking FIFO paths.
Exercises Unix hard-link and inode replacement behavior during atomic vault publication.
Exercises Unix inode-bound snapshot reads while the visible vault path is replaced.
Exercises Unix descriptor-based size revalidation immediately before snapshot allocation.
Exercises Unix descriptor and inode binding when a vault ancestor directory is replaced.
Exercises Unix inode replacement during password work and requires unlock to fail closed.
Exercises Unix in-place vault rewriting during password work and requires unlock to fail closed.
